constraints.name: no_adjacent_different_groups
constraints.description: No two soldiers from different groups may sit on neighboring seats, where neighboring seats are defined as pairs {1,2}, {3,4}, {4,5}, {5,6}, {7,8} in the same row.
constraints.formal: ∀ row r, ∀ neighbor pair (s1, s2) ∈ {{1,2},{3,4},{4,5},{5,6},{7,8}}, if seat s1 and s2 are occupied then group(s1) == group(s2).
